verdict.rationale: INPI's own docs say founders can follow and manage their formalities from dashboards and see how far processing has progressed. A dedicated « Suivre l'avancement du dépôt d'actes » view gives an overview of submitted filings. However, this tracking is described inside the authenticated Guichet unique account, not on publicly accessible status pages, and the free public registry covers registered data rather than in-flight case status. Missing for 10: status lookup on genuinely public (unauthenticated) pages, detail on the status stages and granularity shown, independent or hands-on corroboration that tracking works as described.
